blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Sonny Wagdos, the Philippine marathon record holder, has withdrawn from Saturday’s Asian Games 2026 marathon after coming down with a high fever. Wagdos expressed regret over needing to pull out of the race due to illness. I don’t know why, maybe it’s hard to adapt to the weather from hot to cold. Sayang talaga preparation namin,” Wagdos said in a Facebook post.
